title: Without See Financial Data the Convert and Change category actions are hidden
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, category Goodwill, in status Approved.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' but not 'See Financial Data', at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
  3. Open work order 2.
  4. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers no "Convert to No Charge", as it offers no "Add Work Order Fee / Discount".

Step 3:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 4:

  • The menu offers no "Convert to Billable" and no "Change category".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-N2: “If the user does not have 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' and 'See Financial Data', the Convert to No Charge, Convert to Billable and Change category actions are not shown in the menu and the checkbox is not shown in the New Work Order dialog, as Add Work Order Fee / Discount is not offered.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “No Charge at creation, Convert to No Charge, Convert to Billable, Change category | 'Work Orders — Create & Edit' and 'See Financial Data' | Checkbox and actions hidden, as Add Work Order Fee / Discount (S2-N2)”
